creature_families: elite variants (33 top-level names with an Elite suffix)
colour-prefixed families: crimson-flame (13), bloody (9), gray (6), underground (5), cursed (5), twisted (3), chaos goblins in four colours (4), monkeys in four colours (4)
elemental triads repeated across three zone variants (elemental beast, elemental knight, devil fairy)
tree and plant monsters (DeathTree, GrayDeathTree, swamp ent)
brood and cluster objects (spider eggs, three variants)
named bosses sharing the normal monster base class (model set in the class; phase logic not in client)
generic numbered classes (20) with no name
counts: 399 top-level classes, 58 in Monsters/BloodCastle, 48 in Monsters/NewYearChinese; escalation with level is server data, not read

top_creatures.label: Slow-falling ember flier
top_creatures.why: Death animation plays at 0.22 speed so the fall reads as a long descent; separate idle and attack cues
top_creatures.keep: slow final fall as a boss-kill moment

top_creatures.label: Hit-reacting hatchling dragon
top_creatures.why: Plays its attack cue when hit, walks at a slower action speed (0.7), has its own death cue

top_creatures.label: Oversized brute
top_creatures.why: One class scales a common model up by 30 percent so the creature reads bigger at spawn
top_creatures.keep: fixed scale-up as an elite cue

top_creatures.label: Cool-rim elite crust
top_creatures.why: Monster shader in simple colour mode with a cool cyan tint at high intensity, so the elite glows with no extra effect
top_creatures.change: hue, shape, and cap the intensity for phones

top_creatures.label: Scorched bull elite
top_creatures.why: Dark warm tint at lower intensity gives an ember-tinged elite without a new model
top_creatures.keep: warm tint on an existing base

top_creatures.label: Walking tree stalker
top_creatures.why: Tree-type enemy family; a walking tree reads well at 375 wide
top_creatures.keep: tree silhouette and bark-leaf palette idea
top_creatures.change: bark, leaves, motion. Attack behaviour not read (model load only)

top_creatures.label: Elemental beast across zones
top_creatures.why: The same beast family placed as three zone variants, so one family reskins per zone
top_creatures.keep: a family that travels across zones
top_creatures.change: colours and design per zone. Behaviour not read

top_creatures.label: Brood cluster
top_creatures.why: Egg-brood classes make a cluster object act as a monster, a swarm-spawner read
top_creatures.change: egg design and hatch cue. Behaviour not read

classes: Dark Wizard: ranged caster; area and target spells (Client.Data/BMD/SkillDefinitions.cs:17-27); base class then advanced path (Client.Main/Controls/UI/Game/BloodCastleEnterControl.cs:678-681)
Dark Knight: melee; can summon a Dark Knight (SkillDefinitions.cs:53, skill 34); base class
Fairy Elf: ranged support; buff effects (Client.Main/Objects/Effects/ElfBuff*.cs, names read); skill range 27-52 (SkillDefinitions.cs:46); base class
Magic Gladiator: hybrid melee and caster; advanced in move-command set (Client.Main/Controls/UI/Game/MoveCommandWindow.cs:174-176)
Dark Lord: leader; its own stat row for the Dark Lord family (Client.Main/Controls/UI/Game/Character/CharacterInfoWindowControl.cs:847-945); skills 230-270 (SkillDefinitions.cs:116)
Rage Fighter: martial melee; skills 230-270; rage blow effect (Client.Main/Objects/Effects/RagefulBlowEffect.cs, name read)
Duel Master, Lord Emperor, Fist Master: advanced names only (MoveCommandWindow.cs:174-176); progression not read
Races and factions: none separate in the client; class is the only identity axis read
Class enum (CharacterClassNumber) declaration not found in repo; class IDs unverified
weapon_families: spear (item group 3; a named polearm at group + 7, name only)
Special properties: excellent and ancient flags per hand (Client.Main/Objects/Player/PlayerObject.cs:885-914). Set bonuses not in client
gear_tiers: Levels 7-8: echo layers at low ghost intensity (ItemMaterial.fx:213-216)
Levels 10 and up: stronger echo; ghostIntensity = 0.7 + (itemLevel / 30) uses integer division so 10-15 get the same value (ItemMaterial.fx:229; may be a bug, check before copying)
Excellent: any option value above 15 sets the flag (ItemMaterial.fx:195); spectrum ramp (ItemMaterial.fx:125-134) and six echo layers (ItemMaterial.fx:245-265)
Ancient: two slow echo layers (ItemMaterial.fx:241-243, 258-259) and a cool trail colour (Client.Main/Objects/Player/WeaponObject.cs:138-143)
Ancient set complete: server flag (Client.Main/Networking/PacketHandling/Handlers/ScopeHandler.cs:670-815); NPC shows five ancient armour pieces (Client.Main/Objects/NPCS/Leo.cs:25-29)
Material tiers (cloth to plate, mythic metals): NOT read; item data is in Client.Data/BMD/ItemBMD.cs (not read) and the external data pack
17 wing and cape entries (Client.Data/ModelType.cs, wing group; Client.Main/Objects/Wings/Wing403.cs, WingObject.cs names read)
Excellent mount variant (Client.Main/Objects/Player/PlayerObject.cs:101 speed constant, :1784 excellent vehicle check)
zones: Town and hub: Lorencia, Noria, Devias, Elbeland, Santa village, Loren market, event square, stadium, arena (Client.Main/Worlds/*World.cs)

Field: Tarkan, Atlans, Icarus, Vulcanus, Ferea, Nars, Debenter, Uruk mountain 1-3, swamps of darkness and peace, valley of Loren, Acheron, Aida, ashen Aida, Crywolf, Nixie's lake, Kubera mine, ignis volcano, tormenta island, lost tower, refine tower
Gate-series gauntlets: Blood Castle 1-8 (8), Chaos Castle 1-7 (7), Devil Square (2), Kalima 1-7 (7), Deep Dungeon 1-5 (5)
Event instances: Illusion Temple (6 incl. league), Doppelganger (6), Imperial Guardian (4), Kanturu (3), Abyss of Atlans (3), Balgass barracks and refuge (2), Karutan (2)
Hazard: lava tile object on map tile type 7 (Client.Main/Worlds/TarkanWorld.cs:45; Client.Main/Objects/Worlds/Tarkan/LavaObject.cs)
Weather: ambient snow, toggled by settings (Client.Main/Objects/Worlds/Devias/DeviasSnowAmbientEffect.cs; Client.Main/Worlds/DeviasWorld.cs:23-27)
Per-zone water and grass settings: Client.Main/Worlds/LorenciaWorld.cs:55-60, NoriaWorld.cs:69-74, NewLoginWorld.cs:41-44

looks.label: Excellent spectrum and echo
looks.technique: three-hue ramp with no green, plus six sampled echo layers at small time-driven UV offsets, shimmer on normal

looks.label: Level ladder glow
looks.technique: brightness and echo strength step up at levels 7, 9 and 10

looks.label: Slow ancient echo
looks.technique: two sampled echo layers on slow sine offsets, quieter than excellent

looks.label: Elite gold default
looks.technique: default warm gold glow colour, metallic gain, shimmer from time and normal, echo layers (AU006 covers the shader)

looks.label: Per-elite tint
looks.technique: simple colour mode with a per-class glow colour and intensity; two classes set it

looks.label: Weapon trail by tier
looks.technique: trail colour chosen from ancient, excellent and level flags with a base colour

looks.label: Phoenix slow death
looks.technique: death action play speed reduced so the fall is long

looks.label: Lava blended tile
looks.technique: inverse-destination blend, lit, transparent map object

looks.label: Elf buff orbit and sparkle
looks.technique: orbiting light, mist emitter, sparkle and trail particles (names read, code not read)
